$comment: Catalog-priority base statuses for the member-facing current-demand collection.
Each entry's baseStatus is the adversarially-verified per-category status from
entry). groupId joins the product-activation overlay
category's own adjudicated status is carried by that exact overlay entry; a
category card whose research-lane variant is request-only does NOT inherit a
provider-variant overlay entry. resolveActivationStatus is monotonically
restrictive, so this file can never grant presentation the catalog does not
already grant. A demand key absent from this file projects 'unavailable'
